READ THE NUMBER HONESTLY

What is timed?

Included
CSV parsing, row validation, stage-aware analysis, scoring, and deterministic sorting.
Excluded
Data generation, file reading, network time, and rendering thousands of queue cards.
Report
Median, interpolated p95, throughput, and a fixed correctness signature.

Local benchmark, not a production-capacity claim. Timings vary by device and browser.

FAIRNESS
BOUNDARY

WHAT THIS NUMBER IS — AND ISN'T

Priority describes workflow delay, not a person.

The index uses stage age, the applicable limit, an overdue recorded commitment, waiting responsibility, and contact age. It never predicts quality, interest, performance, or hire probability.

FAIL CLOSED / SAFETY CONTRACT

A queue should never outrun its evidence.

Driftline limits what enters, what influences priority, and what can leave the browser.

01

Bound the workload

Files above 2 MB, 25,000 rows, or 64 columns are rejected before ranking.

02

Quarantine ambiguity

Missing or duplicate headers, duplicate IDs, invalid stages, and contradictory dates never enter the queue.

03

Minimize data

Identity is display-only. Sensitive and extra columns are ignored and excluded from exports.

04

Require a person

Exports are labeled NEEDS_HUMAN_REVIEW and WORKFLOW_DELAY_ONLY. Nothing is sent or written automatically.

DRIFTLINE / PROTOTYPE 01
Synthetic data only. Human review is mandatory.

Deterministic rules · zero runtime AI · CSV data stays in this browser · no upload endpoint

AUDIT VIEW / VERSION 1

How Driftline decides

01

Validate first

Required fields, ISO dates, recognized stages, waiting responsibility, future movement dates, and duplicate IDs are checked before ranking. Invalid rows stay visible.

02

Apply a stage-aware limit

The base limit is multiplied by a visible stage factor and rounded up. Offer is 0.5×; assessment is 1.5×; applied, recruiter screen, and interview are 1×.

03

Rank the follow-up load

Index = floor(100 × days ÷ limit) + 30 for an overdue promise + 15/8/0 for company/external/candidate responsibility + contact age capped at 20.

04

Keep the decision human

Fixed templates explain the facts and suggest an action. Driftline never advances, rejects, messages, or edits a candidate record.

05

Fail closed on unsafe structure

Missing or duplicate headers and workload-limit breaches produce a visible error and an empty queue instead of a partial ranking.

06

Label every export

Queue exports carry NEEDS_HUMAN_REVIEW, WORKFLOW_DELAY_ONLY, and the as-of date so the boundary survives outside this page.

Same input + same settings = same queue.
